scope: Broaden the open-source DWG/DXF 3D route screen across DXF entity parsers, DWG/DXF codecs, bare ACIS/SAB readers, kernels, and native consumers; reconcile candidate independence and define an event-triggered stop rule that returns effort to local implementation.

method.kind: Read-only review of current primary project documentation, package metadata, API documentation, and the existing implementation plan
method.evidenceRule: Public capability listings are candidate-discovery evidence, not runtime qualification. Separate the outer DWG/DXF parser, AcDs/owner join, bare payload parser, B-rep/kernel, and native consumer; account for shared source and kernel lineage. ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG layout.

observed: The repository README advertises 3DSOLID in its entity input list.
The npm package page identifies version 0.3.2 as the latest and records publication more than three years earlier.
The same README lists OBJECTS parsing as unfinished; the repository listing is not evidence of payload interpretation, writer parity, or B-rep construction.
findings.disposition: Stale DXF entity-recognition lead only; no runtime/install or ACIS semantic gate.

observed: The published contract says model construction validates reference closure, not B-rep validity or compatibility with a particular Inventor/ASM version.
Its SAB reader consumes a bare payload; extraction of an outer container is a separate responsibility.
The crate does not construct OCCT solids.
findings.disposition: Bounded parser/model-structure evidence only; not an outer-container, geometry-kernel, or native-consumer vote.

observed: The pinned crate documents selected bare SAT/SAB profiles and a neutral model/loss-report route.
It does not parse DWG/DXF/AcDs ownership and does not provide a geometry kernel.
The plan already records the release and its bounded admission.
findings.disposition: No new gate or runtime; reuse the existing optional payload-comparator checkpoint.

observed: OpenCADStudio identifies ACadRust as its native DWG/DXF engine, so those are not independent outer-parser lineages.
The separately documented tessellation path includes direct per-surface fallback and can mark results incomplete.
findings.disposition: Keep parser, kernel, display fallback, and native acceptance as separate evidence lanes.

observed: The newly surfaced Aetheris repository describes an experimental STEP AP242-oriented geometric kernel and STEP output; the reviewed project summary does not establish SAT/SAB, DWG, or DXF input routes.
CADKernel's detailed supported-format table marks ACIS SAT/SAB unsupported, while broad headline compatibility claims coexist with a FAQ that says commercial CAD import is planned.
These are self-reported source/documentation observations, not executed results.
findings.disposition: Do not admit either project as an ACIS/DWG/DXF peer based on kernel or headline claims. Reconsider only after a pinned, source-visible route demonstrates the relevant input/output artifact and locally controlled behavior. This adds no evidence to the current gates.

observed: The current @tarikjabiri/dxf 2.9.0 package and dxfjs/writer release establish an active DXF generator route.
The reviewed package-level evidence does not establish general 3D modeler-geometry authoring or semantic-readback capability.
findings.disposition: Retain locally generated controls as default; admit only for a specific missing DXF tag-authoring check after source/API review.

researchStopRule: Name the exact missing evidence layer before searching for another peer.
Require pinned source/release, dependency and license/use review, control provenance, and parser/kernel/consumer lineage.
Require a concrete implementation-ready control and pass/fail criterion; otherwise classify NO_NEW_EVIDENCE and do not install, clone, or run the candidate.
Reopen peer discovery only after a relevant pinned source change, reproducible peer failure, or already-authorized candidate that can fill an explicit deferred gate.
External availability must not block local generated-test implementation slices.
planDelta.followUpSweepConclusion: A fresh discovery sweep surfaced Aetheris and refreshed CADKernel's public format claims. Aetheris is STEP-oriented in the reviewed material; CADKernel explicitly marks ACIS SAT/SAB unsupported. No newly qualified DWG/DXF-to-ACIS semantic route was found, so no peer gate or implementation action changes.
